functions.name: central
functions.description: Discovery and characterization of cohort-specific DNA methylation patterns: federated linear SVM (squared hinge, exact Newton), C selected by cross-validation, leave-one-hospital-out validation and CpG stability.

arguments.name: input_source
arguments.description: 'Result of a previous task': this run uses the result of the task you give below. 'Upload my own file': upload a JSON file instead, e.g. for different data.

arguments.name: features_task_id
arguments.description: Id of a finished Elastic Net task, shown on its task page: this run uses its selected CpGs and, if Cohorts is empty, its cohorts Leave empty to use the most recent finished Elastic Net task of this session; the result's Input table shows which one was used.

arguments.name: features
arguments.description: A JSON list of CpG IDs; every hospital needs all of them

arguments.name: outcome_column
arguments.description: Column with the predefined cohort of each sample

arguments.name: classes
arguments.description: Cohorts to compare; two give one hyperplane, more give one-vs-rest. Empty: all cohorts with at least min_samples samples

arguments.name: reference_cohort
arguments.description: Optional reference group (e.g. controls)

arguments.name: C_grid
arguments.description: Candidate regularization values

arguments.name: n_folds
arguments.description: Number of local stratified cross-validation folds

arguments.name: max_rounds
arguments.description: Per model

arguments.name: tolerance
arguments.description: Convergence tolerance on the gradient norm, relative to the initial one

arguments.name: random_seed
arguments.description: Seed for the local fold assignment

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum samples a node pools before returning any aggregate

arguments.name: run_loho
arguments.description: Validate on hospitals not used for training

arguments.name: stability_top_k
arguments.description: Size of the top-ranked CpG set in the stability analysis

arguments.name: sample_column
arguments.description: Sample column when the data has one row per sample and probe (v6-extractionIDAT-py)

arguments.name: value_column
arguments.description: beta or m_value, when the data has one row per sample and probe

arguments.name: features_selected_on_same_samples
arguments.description: Whether the CpGs were selected on these same samples (e.g. by Elastic Net); only changes the summary text: the accuracies are then optimistic

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Hospitals (organizations) to use; empty = all of the collaboration

ui_visualizations.name: Input
ui_visualizations.description: Where this run's input came from

ui_visualizations.name: Performance
ui_visualizations.description: Balanced accuracy with 95% interval (cross-validation and leave-one-hospital-out) and stability

ui_visualizations.name: Ranked CpGs
ui_visualizations.description: CpGs of each comparison by size of the coefficient

functions.name: apply_model
functions.description: Apply a finished SVM model, unchanged, to the samples of chosen hospitals (e.g. a hospital that took no part in selecting the CpGs or training) and report how well it classifies them: per hospital and pooled, with 95% intervals. Only counts leave the hospitals.

arguments.name: input_source
arguments.description: 'Result of a previous task': this run uses the result of the task you give below. 'Upload my own model': upload a JSON file instead, e.g. for different data.

arguments.name: model_task_id
arguments.description: Id of a finished SVM task, shown on its task page: its model is applied Leave empty to use the most recent finished SVM training task of this session; the result's Input table shows which one was used.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description: A model as JSON with features, classes, weights, biases, mean and std

arguments.name: outcome_column
arguments.description: Column with the true cohort of each sample

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Hospitals (organizations) to use; empty = all of the collaboration

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum evaluated samples a hospital needs before it returns its counts

arguments.name: sample_column
arguments.description: Sample column when the data has one row per sample and probe

arguments.name: value_column
arguments.description: beta or m_value, as used to train the model

ui_visualizations.name: Input
ui_visualizations.description: Where this run's input came from

ui_visualizations.name: Performance
ui_visualizations.description: Balanced accuracy with 95% interval per hospital and pooled
